model_output.verdict: A senior FP&A analyst with budget, forecasting and pricing work tied to substantial results.
write_up: Your resume is strong because it connects consumer-brand finance work to decisions and results. At Lakeshore Foods, you own a division budget, improve forecasting and model pricing for products. A recruiter can see both the work and its scale.

The forecast line is the model to copy: it names what you built and shows the change in error. Your progression from Financial Analyst at Midway Brands to Senior Financial Analyst at Lakeshore Foods is easy to follow.

I'd make one small improvement to the pricing line: show how your work fed into the review. Otherwise, your resume is unlikely to be what stands between you and a callback. How competitive a particular role is will also matter.
